title: XUAT-Copilot: Multi-Agent Collaborative System for Automated User Acceptance Testing with Large Language Model

defines.name: XUAT-Copilot
defines.definition: An LLM-powered multi-agent collaborative system for automating user acceptance testing by generating and executing test scripts from test cases.

problem: Current UAT automation remains labor-intensive because human testers still manually implement test scripts from test cases, especially under condensed instructions, context-sensitive actions, many parameters, and step-by-step correctness requirements.
